== Notes ==
* You cannot use this skill without being at least [[Deldrimor rank]] 1, because it is awarded along with 1,500 reputation points.
*If you would like to have the added benefits of Drunken Master ''without'' the screen effects of being drunk open the game options menu and on the graphics tab uncheck "Enable post process effects".
*The use of one 1 point [[alcohol]] just before you activate the skill is enough to trigger the bonus effects.

== Trivia ==
* The skill animation differs depending on whether you are drunk when you activate it:
** If sober, the ring and keg will appear; 
** If drunk, a ''wobbling'' keg (looking like a [[Keg of Aged Hunter's Ale]]) will appear briefly, followed by the standard animation.
* The skill's name is a reference to the film ''[[W:Drunken Master|Drunken Master]]'' and its [[W:Drunken Master II|sequel]] ([http://wiki.guildwars.com/index.php?title=User_talk:Emily_Diehl/Trivia_archive_2&oldid=671332#reference.3F source]), which are based upon the kung fu styles known colloquially as [[W:Zui Quan|drunken boxing]].
